title: Argentinian Buckwheat Empanadas Jubilant Delight
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, these buckwheat versions are a flavorful and nutritious delight. This recipe combines the earthy taste of buckwheat with the bold flavors of Argentina.

ingredients.name: jubilant argentinian seasoning blend
ingredients.notes: available at your local spice shop

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine buckwheat flour and jubilant argentinian seasoning blend.
Gradually add water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the sweet potato and black bean mixture in the center of each circle.
Brush the edges with vegetable oil and fold the dough in half to form a half-circle.
Press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with vegetable oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
